scope: Selected Highland Creek single-family sales; not a comprehensive Ridgefield or Bell's Mills inventory. No parcel-level village assignment established.

metadata.coverage: Address lookup: Ridgefield and Bell’s Mills. Comparison sales: mapped Mecklenburg County portion of Highland Creek. Cabarrus sales are not included.
metadata.eligibility: County-recorded single-family sales, not sold vacant, positive price, warranty/special-warranty deeds, with no county disqualification code or reason. A blank flag is not certification of an arm’s-length sale.
limitations: County records can lag and differ from MLS measurements.
Five nearest eligible records in this snapshot, not necessarily the five best valuation comparables.
County-flagged or under-review transfers and incomplete records are excluded.
Not an appraisal, price estimate, legal survey or complete MLS inventory.

mlsContext.scope: Charlotte listings reported as Highland Creek; single-family residential; Closed; Canopy MLS originating system; excludes ListingVisibility FRME
mlsContext.disclaimer: Based on information from Canopy MLS for the period March 13, 2026 through September 13, 2026 for Charlotte single-family residential closed listings reported as Highland Creek. Properties may be listed or sold by various participants of the MLS. Information deemed reliable but not guaranteed. MLS search labels are not parcel-verified village boundaries.
mlsContext.interpretation: In this closed-sale group, median cumulative market time was 9 days while the average was 42 days. That gap shows why one neighborhood timing number cannot predict how quickly a particular home will sell.
notClaims: No neighborhood-wide trend without prior period
